messages:
elaine (product): Quick sync — we need to define launch gates for Private (VPC + on-prem) before next quarter. Major open items: upgrade path for customers, customer-managed networking UX, GA vs beta feature set. Thoughts?

sam (eng-platform): +1. Propose MVP scope: customer-supplied VPC subnets & SGs, on-prem installer (IPv4), upgrade tooling that does rolling node replacement. Keep advanced features out of GA.

jordyn (solutions): From the field: customers expect BYO KMS, clear network diagrams, and an explicit rollback window. They also want sample terraform + routetable examples.

ravi (eng-ml): Heads-up — we can't support mixed-arch nodes in a single cluster for GA. That affects upgrade sequencing if a customer swaps hardware during an upgrade.

elaine (product): Draft acceptance criteria for GA suggestion: 1) published network topology + TF examples 2) KMS integration documented and smoke-tested 3) documented upgrade path with maximum control-plane disruption <2 minutes 4) canary and rollback playbooks + automated e2e smoke tests.

sam (eng-platform): Control-plane <2m is aggressive but doable if we limit scope: rolling control-plane leader election + graceful API handoff. Node replacement + health checks will be the main work. I can own the upgrade script.

elaine (product): assigning upgrade script to @sam. Make SLA for control-plane disruption explicit in the checklist. Also need a clear migration path for existing Hosted customers migrating to Dedicated/Private.

jordyn (solutions): Migration asks: sample iptables/nftables rules, loadbalancer config snippets, and a troubleshooting checklist for routing mismatches. I'll draft a "migration-assist" doc. :memo:

ci-bot: Build 8721 passed: private-deploy/installer v0.3.4 smoke tests ✅

ravi (eng-ml): For on-prem installs, please add an opt-in telemetry flag for perf regressions (off by default). Some customers insist on zero telemetry.

elaine (product): Agreed — telemetry opt-in only. Action items & owners: sam: upgrade script + H/A test plan (due Tue) | jordyn: migration-assist doc + TF examples (due Fri) | ravi: telemetry opt-in spec (due Thu) | me: launch gates doc + GA checklist (due Mon).

sam (eng-platform): I'll open a PR with the initial script + README today and tag @elaine for review.

jordyn (solutions): I'll create the doc skeleton in Confluence and paste the link here once live.

elaine (product): Final decision on customer-managed networking for MVP: customers supply subnets, route tables, and security groups. We will not ship IPAM or eBPF firewall integrations in GA; defer to post-GA. :white_check_mark:

sam (eng-platform): +1 to deferring advanced network integrations.

ravi (eng-ml): Also: quantify memory/compute profiles for on-prem models (quantization + runtime tweaks) — separate follow-up item for platform roadmap.

elaine (product): Noted and added to follow-up backlog. Thanks everyone — closing this thread unless new asks pop up.
